about: Paid spend per customer with at least two paid orders, highest first. The data has a refunded order (Ana), a one-order customer (Bo) and a customer with only refunds (Di), so each near miss shows.
good: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

WITH paid AS (SELECT customer_id, total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid')
SELECT name, (SELECT SUM(total) FROM paid WHERE customer_id = c.id) AS s
FROM customers c
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid WHERE customer_id = c.id) >= 2
ORDER BY s DESC
